## Goal

Add onboarding and permission states, explicit exclusions, command/path redaction, retention caps, overload backpressure, resource-budget instrumentation, signing/notarization documentation, and safe uninstall behavior.

## Deliverables

- Privacy and redaction controls
- Resource budgets and backpressure
- Permissions and distribution runbook
- Safety/performance evidence

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-420-01` — Privacy fixtures leak no configured sensitive values or contents; sustained-load evidence stays within declared CPU, memory, database-growth, and event-loss budgets; permission refusal and uninstall preserve user-controlled evidence predictably.
